scope: Author-safe repository-source capability map. Existing symbols are implementation evidence, not selected target qualification or achieved performance.
target_traits: noncoherent cached host where selected execution contract declares it
claim_policy: No chip-name taxonomy or private kernel information
Apply only when all source numeric, effect, ownership and target capability obligations hold
Do not run every pass indiscriminately; select pass order and inspect emitted realization
No product-support claims for precision/vector/asynchronous starter sets; no external software facts used

extension_policy.admission: New mechanisms are welcome. Discoveries do not grant inaccessible source or evaluator access. Validate correctness and compare performance in one model epoch.

capability_selection.authority: software/target specification constrained by selected RTL facts and execution contract
capability_selection.rule: Offer a mechanism only when all required traits are supported. Unsupported hides it. Unknown yields a discovery request, not active optimization guidance. Workload and compiler prerequisites come from actual IR and available APIs, not architecture tags.
capability_selection.runtime_rule: ROCm is an optional software runtime, not a hardware capability or implied consequence of DMA. It is not selected for this bare-metal Gemmini campaign.
capability_selection.composition: Intersect capability requirements, then workload prerequisites and current library access. Do not union entire architecture category menus.
